issues.description: Data race on playerPositions: the write in feedAudio(UUID, short[], double[]) at line 57 (playerPositions.put) happens outside the ReentrantLock, while all reads (playerPositions.get in feedAudio(UUID, short[])) and other writes (playerPositions.remove in closeSession/checkIdleSessions) happen inside the lock. HashMap is not thread-safe — concurrent unsynchronized put with synchronized remove/get can cause stale reads or map corruption. Fix: move the playerPositions.put inside the lock, e.g. by acquiring the lock before writing, or restructuring to pass the position through to the inner feedAudio method which already holds the lock.

summary: Found 1 issue: a data race on the new playerPositions HashMap where an unsynchronized write can race with synchronized reads/writes. This should be fixed before merging.
